facts.statement: The name Thililua comes from an ancient aquatic god in local Berber mythology.
facts.quote: The name Thililua is derived from that of an ancient aquatic god from local Berber mythology

facts.statement: The species name longicollis refers to the animal's long neck.
facts.quote: longicollis refers to the animal's long neck

facts.statement: Thililua fossils were found in Late Cretaceous (early Turonian) rocks in the High Atlas mountains of Morocco.
facts.quote: Thililua has been found in Late Cretaceous (early Turonian) rocks in the High Atlas mountains of Morocco in north Africa

facts.statement: Thililua is the first Polycotylid plesiosaur discovered in Africa and the first one found to have lived at a subtropical latitude.
facts.quote: Thililua is the first Polycotylid plesiosaur discovered in Africa, and also the first discovered that lived at a subtropical latitude

facts.statement: In 2010, researchers transferred Thililua to the family Leptocleididae as a sister taxon to Nichollssaura.
facts.quote: In 2010, Thililua was transferred to Leptocleididae as a sister taxon to Nichollssaura

facts.statement: The type specimen of Thililua longicollis, described in 2003, includes an almost complete skull and lower jaw with 37 vertebrae.
facts.quote: The type specimen of T. longicollis, which was described in 2003, consists of an almost complete skull and lower jaw, articulated with 37 vertebrae

facts.statement: The estimated total length of Thililua was between 5.5 and 6 meters.
facts.quote: the estimated total length of Thililua was 5.5 to 6 metres

facts.statement: Ketchum and Benson (2011) reassigned Thililua back to its original position as a Polycotylid.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, Ketchum y Benson (2011) reasignaron a Thililua a su posición original, como policotílido

facts.statement: Thililua lived between 93.9 and 89.8 million years ago during the Turonian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Turonian to Turonian (93.9 to 89.8 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Thililua had 30 neck vertebrae, an unusually high number compared to other Polycotylids.
rejected.quote: Of these vertebrae, 30 were cervical (neck) vertebrae, which is an unusually high number compared to other Polycotylids
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'an unusually high number compared to other Polycotylids'
